ns2:course.label: Tchg Elem Science I
ns2:course.description: Course is the first of two, 3-hour science methods courses in the elementary education program, which will examine elementary science content, learning theory, and the teaching of science in the elementary school. 2 or 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Admission to the Elementary Teacher Education Program.
